name: tp-integrador-ia-root
description: TP Integrador IA - Traductor de Manga (Mono-repo: Frontend + Functions)

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd functions && npm run dev"
scripts.build:all: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../functions && npm run build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage:all: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../functions && npm install && cd ..
